major.rule: 0.Y.Z -> 1.0.0 is reserved strictly for public GitHub release of Alchemical-3D/Homunculus (requires --allow-v1-public-release). Post-1.0.0 major bumps require breaking schema/CLI changes.
major.required_gate: Full Profile 6 Benchmark Suite + Compare-Full Subagent Gate + Immutable RAID Deliverable Snapshot.

minor.rule: Triggered by major architectural overhauls, multi-sprint subsystem rebuilds, new core skills/add-ons, new client adapters, or JSON/memory schema expansions. Resets patch Z to 0.
minor.required_gate: Full Profile 6 Benchmark Suite (0 unresolved regressions vs baseline) + Git Tag v0.Y.0 + Immutable RAID Snapshot.

patch.rule: Triggered by targeted bug fixes, false-positive/false-negative validator closures, regex/qualifier refinements, rule/skill prose trims, single-script latency optimizations, or new unit/+faults tests without schema changes.
patch.required_gate: Targeted Subsystem Benchmark Profile (0 regressions) + Unit Tests PASS + Git Tag v0.y.Z.

version_history.reason: Consolidated Single-Source Clean-Room Homunculus baseline on development workstation (101 files, Stateful Memory v1.1, 0 duplicate copies).
